claims.text: Different kinds of offensive content explored include hate speech, cyberbullying, aggression, toxic comments, and abusive language.
The research categorizes offensive content into targeted and untargeted insults and threats.
A fine-grained classification of offensive content includes categories such as profanity, insult, and abuse.
The study also emphasizes the importance of identifying the target of offensive language in various scenarios.
